data.description: Spacious 2BR | Prime Waterfront Living | Le Pont
data.display_address: Port de La Mer, La Mer, Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience coastal living at its finest in this elegant 2-bedroom apartment located in Le Pont Building 3 at Port de La Mer. Inspired by Mediterranean charm and set within one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront communities, this residence offers a perfect blend of tranquility, modern comfort, and seaside lifestyle. With spacious interiors and scenic surroundings, it’s ideal for both end-users and investors.

Property Details:

2 Bedrooms
2 Bathrooms
Size: 1,219 sq ft
Open-plan living and dining area
Contemporary kitchen with high-quality finishes
Built-in wardrobes
Private balcony (community and/or sea views)
Dedicated parking space

Property Amenities:

Private beach access
Infinity swimming pools
Fully equipped gymnasium
Landscaped walkways and marina promenade
Cafés, restaurants, and boutique retail outlets
Children’s play areas
24/7 security and concierge services
Yacht marina access

Location Highlights:

Located in the prestigious Jumeirah 1 district
Easy access to La Mer beachfront and leisure attractions
10 minutes to City Walk
15 minutes to Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa
Close proximity to top schools and healthcare facilities
Quick connectivity to major road networks
